name: Top Breeder
source:
A human type pet has been recently developed and became a hit. Main character enters an "Official breeder license exam" that lasts 6 weeks in order to be able to discipline human pets. There is cat-girl, a dog-girl, a bird-girl and a rabbit-girl. But protagonist's girlfriend is getting jealous. Will the exam successfully come to an end?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
最近开发出了一种人形宠物，迅速大受欢迎。为了获得训练人形宠物的资格，主人公参加了为期六周的“正式饲养师执照考试”。宠物包括猫女孩、狗女孩、鸟女孩和兔女孩。然而，主人公的女友却开始吃醋。他能顺利通过考试吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
